captions.facebook: A day to remember at Old Lions Oval! 🏏 Thabo Mokoena struck a magnificent hundred on Saturday 31 October, making 112 off 118 balls with 11 fours and 3 sixes against Kensington Ridge CC in Round 4 of the Premier League. A proper captain's knock in a 50-over home fixture, and the Oval loved every minute of it. Take a bow, Thabo! 🦁
